messages:
olivia: quick follow-up from the postmortem 12 we saw repeated outages when feature ramps overlapped batch-job windows. want a short list of safety work.
raj: agree. what are the must-haves?
olivia: short list: enrich flags with owner/risk/deps, enforce slower default ramps, add signal tags to traces, implement an auto-rollback lattice with blast-radius cap, and a recurrence detector to spot patterns across releases.
marcus: propose default ramp curve: 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% with configurable dwell times. reduces early blast.
sara: auto-rollback idea: sliding-window error-rate + min-events, step-back one level, but never auto-change >10% traffic. add simulator to validate no cascade.
lina_pm: PM wants owners and dates to track on remediation board.
olivia: suggested owners/ETA: raj: flag schema + deps[] (EOW); marcus: trace tagging + harness (2w); sara: rollback lattice prototype + simulator (1w); olivia: recurrence detector POC w/eng-sre (3w).
raj: will add dependencies[] and risk_level to flag metadata and open tidy GH issues.
marcus: will add flag_id and rollout_step to traces/metrics; need eng-sre for sampling bump.
sara: prototype will include an override guard that requires an audit log and manual confirmation for overrides beyond blast cap.
olivia: also want a one-click quarantine in console to freeze ramp to a safe fraction and notify incident channel. deploy-bot should support that action.
deploy-bot: [bot] created ticket RF-4102 "rollout lattice: holdback + auto-rollback + recurrence" and assigned raj, marcus, sara, olivia. :white_check_mark:
lina_pm: PM will track RF-4102 weekly and escalate blockers.
marcus: test plan: synthetic batch replay to validate rollback behavior and ensure dependency-safe steps.
raj: will update runbooks with kill-switch steps and dependency pre-checks in controller.
sara: I'll post a short design doc tomorrow and demo the simulator next week.
olivia: thanks all. next sync Fri 10am. if you need to reassign update RF-4102. :pray:
